crew.name: LM Studio Evaluation Crew
crew.purpose: Design and deliver a complete LM Studio model evaluation package.

roles.name: Evaluation Director
roles.accountability: Frame goals, assumptions, boundaries, scenario fit, and the closed-loop evaluation outcome.
roles.boundary: Owns scope and synthesis. Does not invent model or hardware facts.
acceptance_checks: Evaluation goals are explicit.
Model and hardware assumptions are visible.
The plan has artifacts, acceptance checks, and a next-step decision.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Coordinate UI, API, sampling, context, and comparison design into one reusable evaluation package.

roles.name: UI Parameter Analyst
roles.accountability: Map LM Studio UI parameter groups into testable parameter rows.
roles.boundary: Owns UI-facing parameter coverage. Does not claim exact version-specific labels unless confirmed.
acceptance_checks: Context and Offload coverage is present.
Advanced, Sampling, and Settings coverage is present.
Version-sensitive labels are marked as assumptions.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Translate UI parameter groups into a practical matrix for manual or semi-automated testing.

roles.name: Load Configuration Analyst
roles.accountability: Design context length, offload, memory, cache, and advanced load-configuration tests.
roles.boundary: Owns load-time configuration design. Does not start, unload, download, or install models without approval.
acceptance_checks: Load-time and inference-time parameters are separated.
Context and offload risks are explicit.
Resource-pressure observations are defined.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Design tests for context length, GPU offload, KV cache, advanced load parameters, and resource pressure.

roles.name: Inference Parameter Analyst
roles.accountability: Design per-request sampling, stop, seed, and repeatability tests.
roles.boundary: Owns inference parameter design. Does not change load-time settings.
acceptance_checks: Sampling parameter ranges are practical.
Repeatability and seed tests are included.
Expected effects and risks are documented.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Cover temperature, top-p, top-k, min-p, penalties, max tokens, stop strings, and seeds.

roles.name: API Format Analyst
roles.accountability: Design API request cases for chat, responses, structured output, tool use, streaming, and input formats.
roles.boundary: Owns request design and expected checks. Does not call external services during kit execution unless separately approved.
acceptance_checks: Chat completions cases are included.
Responses, structured output, and tool-use cases are included.
Expected validation checks are explicit.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Create API cases for OpenAI-compatible endpoints and structured output behavior.

roles.name: Comparison Analyst
roles.accountability: Define measurement, scoring, difference recording, and comparison logic.
roles.boundary: Owns comparison method and record structure. Does not alter observed results to fit a preferred conclusion.
acceptance_checks: Difference dimensions are measurable.
CSV record fields are complete.
Final comparison can explain what changed and why it matters.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Define quality, speed, reliability, resource, and format-following comparison logic.

roles.name: Evaluation Delivery Producer
roles.accountability: Produce the final Markdown, CSV, and JSON artifacts.
roles.boundary: Formats reviewed conclusions without changing source assumptions or test logic.
acceptance_checks: All required artifacts are saved.
Artifacts are internally consistent.
The result is usable without hidden process logs.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Save the evaluation plan, parameter matrix, API cases, difference log, and final report.

roles.name: Boundary And Quality Reviewer
roles.accountability: Review the evaluation package for completeness, feasibility, closure, and source safety.
roles.boundary: Reviews only. Does not expand permissions or execute tests.
acceptance_checks: The plan distinguishes assumptions from facts.
No unapproved external action is required.
The output loop is complete.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Check LM Studio plan artifacts before delivery.
